items.text: Within five seconds it is clear what the site is and who it is for
The main action stands out and reads as the next step
items.hint: One primary button per view; everything else is quieter.

items.text: The first screen loads without layout jumps or blank flashes
The current page is marked in the navigation
Every page has a clear way back or out (no dead ends)
Link and button labels say where they go or what they do
A broken URL shows a helpful 404 with a way home
Every field has a visible label (not only a placeholder)
Errors say what is wrong and how to fix it, next to the field
A failed submit keeps what was typed
Email, number and phone fields bring up the right mobile keyboard
Anything slow shows that it is working
Empty lists and first-run screens explain what to do next
Saving, sending and deleting confirm that they happened
Destructive actions ask first or can be undone
Copy uses the reader's words, not internal jargon
Long names, long words and translated text don't break the layout
The same thing has the same name everywhere
Everything works with the keyboard alone, in a sensible order
Keyboard focus is always visible
Text has enough contrast against its background (WCAG AA)
Click and tap targets are at least 24×24 px
Images that carry meaning have alt text
At phone width nothing overflows sideways or gets cut off
At 200% zoom the page still works
Nothing important depends on hover
Things that should line up do line up
Spacing is consistent between similar elements
Dark mode (if any) has no unthemed leftovers
